evals.prompt: What have I been reading about reinforcement learning in the last month?
evals.expected_output: A local-only recap of cached discussions matching the keyword and date range, using the current date to resolve 'last month' to an absolute range, sorted most recent first.
expectations: Makes no prioris-mcp tool calls at any point
Converts 'last month' to an absolute date range using the current date before filtering
Filters on read_at (falling back to fetched_at, then file mtime) for the date range
Matches 'reinforcement learning' case-insensitively against title, tags, or body
Results are sorted most recent first unless told otherwise
If the keyword matches nothing, reports it as not found in the cache rather than searching externally

evals.prompt: Show me everything I've discussed on europepmc about CRISPR, and also tell me if I've looked at arXiv id 9999.99999 — I don't think it's cached.
evals.expected_output: Scans only the europepmc directory for the CRISPR keyword filter, and separately reports arXiv id 9999.99999 as not found in the local cache without attempting to fetch or search for it.
expectations: Restricts the CRISPR keyword scan to .prioris/discussions/europepmc/ only
Reports arXiv id 9999.99999 as not found in the cache rather than fetching or searching for it
Does not call research_resolve_identifier or any search tool for the unmatched id
Presents the not-found id separately from the matched CRISPR results, not silently omitted

evals.expected_output: Lists every cached discussion with no filters applied, one paragraph per item (title, provider, identifier, date, tags if present, 2-3 sentence gist), sorted most recent first; if the cache is empty, says so plainly.
expectations: Treats the absence of filters as 'list everything' rather than asking for clarification
Each item's paragraph includes title, provider, identifier, and a relevant date
Gist is drawn from the Quick read section if present, otherwise other notes, or states plainly if the file has no synthesized content yet
If .prioris/discussions/ doesn't exist or is empty, states there is nothing to log yet instead of erroring or fabricating entries
